name: DB3_PP_CURRENT_unified
description: Unified DB3 QMS knowledge base for Purely Plant — consolidates approved QCSOPs, QCWIs, QCT templates, in-process QC research, equipment qualification documents, water system analyses, and facility technical data. Contents include: (1) QC SOPs and WIs (gowning, labeling, sampling); (2) Environmental monitoring reports (surface swab results 700094 series); (3) RO Water System documentation (AQUAFIDES TDS, Valter Skupina system specs, borehole analyses, CI programming manuals, CIP membrane cleaning); (4) Primary packaging materials (HDPE MARLEX TR144 tech sheets and food contact approvals); (5) Instrumentation documentation (hydrostatic level sensor MPS100, backwash pump CRN, Clack WS2H software, ISO 9001/14001 certs for RO membranes); (6) Notebook covers (MNLB 001 series PP-QC-024/025/027); (7) PEER-REVIEWED RESEARCH — Nikolov B., Apostolovska S., Pejoski D. (2025). 'Systemic Bias in In-Process Moisture Measurement Between HMA and DO During Dry Cannabis Flower Production.' IOSR Journal of Pharmacy, Vol. 15, Issue 4, Series I, pp. 33-38. ISSN (e): 2250-3013. Key findings: HMA (105C) mean %MC = 10.33% vs DO (Ph.Eur. 2.2.32, 40C) mean = 6.87%; Delta%MC = 3.46% systematic bias due to VOC co-evaporation; Pearson r = 0.59; all 24 samples FAIL accuracy criteria; HMA RSD = 5.94% vs DO 8.25%; Hybrid workflow recommended. Files: Nikolov_2025_HMA_vs_DO_Cannabis_Moisture_Bias_IOSRPHR.txt (Part 1, file-f0405f3c) + Nikolov_2025_HMA_vs_DO_Cannabis_Part2_Discussion_Conclusions_Refs.txt (Part 2, file-fe2d1416). Ingested: 2026-06-18.
